Body Area Networks, Robotic Sensor Networks, Multimedia Sensor Networks.

optionalCourses.title: Power Supply System in Telecommunications

DC Power Supply System: Rectifier mode; Battery mode; Standby parallel mode; Changeover mode; Combined mode; Assignment of operating modes to communication systems; Power-board; Monitoring and control.

AC Power Supply System: Mains mode; AC changeover mode; Uninterruptable ac changeover mode; Uninterruptable standby power supply systems; Public Mains: Type of voltages, Tolerances and Supply frequency, Distortion factor, Measures for reducing retroactive effects, Power failures; Static UPS Systems; Diesel Generating sets.

Transmission System Power Supplies: Power supply for radio link apparatus, satellite ground stations, and submarine cable landing stations; Mains-independent power supply systems.

Grounding and Potential Equalization: Functional and protective grounding; Selection and Design of grounds and grounding systems; Measurement of grounding resistance; Overvoltage sources and interference in telecommunication systems; Protection against overvoltage and interference; Design of the distribution network for EWSD systems; Lightning protection for EWSD systems and telecommunication towers.

Protective Measures for Prevention of Accidents: Protection by disconnection or indication for TN, TT and IT supply systems; Protection without disconnection or indication: Protective insulation, protective separation; Safety instructions.

Dorin O. Neacsu "Telecom Power Systems"

optionalCourses.title: Semiconductor Devices Theory
topics: Electronic band structure, dispersion relation, tight binding model. Lattice vibration: Simple harmonic model, phonon dispersion relation, acoustic and optical phonons. Scattering theory: Fermi-golden rule, scattering rates of different processes, scattering mechanisms in different semiconductors, mobility. Different carrier transport models: Drift-diffusion theory, Boltzman transport equations, ballistic transport, Landauer- Buttiker approach, quantum mechanical model. MOS devices: Band diagram and electrostatics of single gate, double gate, SOI and Fin FET. Carrier transport, I-V and C-V characteristics. Hetero-junction devices: Band alignment, band offset, Anderson’s rule, single and double sided hetero-junctions, quantum wells and quantization effects, lattice mismatch and strain and common hetero-structure material systems. Hetero junction field effect transistor: Structure and principle, band structure, carrier transport and I-V characteristics. Hetero-Junction diode: Band bending, carrier transport and I-V characteristics. Hetero-structure bipolar transistor (HBT): Band bending, carrier transport, Gummel - Poon model.
references: Robert L. Boyelstad "Electronic Devices and Circuit Theory".
Jacob Millman, "Integrated Electronics"
Donald A. Neamen "Semiconductor Physics and Devices: Basic Principles"

optionalCourses.title: Semiconductor Processing and Fabrication Technology

Introduction to Semiconductor Characterization Tools.

Discrete device fabrication: Diode, transistor, resistor and capacitor.

Integrated circuit fabrication: Isolation - pn junction isolation, mesa isolation and oxide isolation. BJT based microcircuits, p-channel and n-channel MOSFETs, complimentary MOSFETs and silicon on insulator devices. Testing, bonding and packaging
references: The Science and Engineering of Microelectronic Fabrication by Stephen A. Campbell (Oxford University Press)

Silicon VLSI Technology: Fundamentals, Practice and Modeling by James D. Plummer, Michael D. Deal and Peter B. Griffin ( Prentice Hall Electronics and VLSI Series )

Manipulators Dynamics: Eular-Lagrange equation, PID control, joint-level control, sensing and control for robot manipulators.
Robot Control Architecture: Trajectory generation and representation; Definition of robot workspace; Point to point robot planning algorithms.
